breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal axial force as piecewise constant, computing separate internal forces for each segment (N_AB = 30000 N, N_BC = -12000 N, N_CD = -20000 N) using section cuts at each loading point. It does not treat the force as uniform along the full length.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly resolves the problem segment by segment, computing distinct stresses (150 MPa, -60 MPa, -100 MPa) and deformations (0.525 mm, -0.180 mm, -0.250 mm) for each segment, then summing them to get the total displacement. There is no reduction to a single net-load stress state.
